data.title: Nara - The Valley
data.about:
Introducing Nara at The Valley, Dubai’s first suburban community. Offering 3 different architectural styles, you can choose from 3 & 4 bedroom townhouses with ample space between them and large sikkas and pocket parks. 

Ideal for your family to enjoy and live the peaceful life, Nara offers the highest standards of amenities and interiors. every townhouse is exquisitely crafted to perfection and is located minutes from the Pavilion and the Golden Beach in the community. The Valley is nestled close to the majority of city’s landmarks.

characteristics_module.title: Ideal & Serene Community Living
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• 3 BR villa starting at AED 1.34 M
  • Choose from 3 different styles
  • Pay 50% during construction & 50% on handover
  • Handover Q4 2024
  • Get 50% waiver on land registration fee
  • Ideal & serene community living
  • Minutes from the major landmarks of the city
  • Large Sikkas, Town Centre, & Pocket Parks

location_tile.title: When you live at Al Andalus, you are living within Jumeirah Golf Estates.
location_tile.description:
Located in Dubailand, The Valley is located along the Al Ain Road which is under expansion. Travel time is just minutes from the majority of Dubai’s landmarks.

  • 5 mins – Dubai Rugby Sevens
  • 8 mins – Dubai Outlet Mall
  • 25 mins – Burj Khalifa & Downtown Dubai
  • 25 mins – Dubai International Airport
